text: Every spacing value (margin, padding, gap) MUST be on the spacing scale 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 px.
checklist: Every spacing number in the polished code is on the spacing scale.

text: Every font size MUST be on the type scale 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 30, 36, 48 px; body text MUST be at least 16 px.
checklist: Every font size is on the type scale and body text is 16 px or more.

text: Body text MUST have line-height 1.5; headings MUST have line-height 1.2 to 1.3; paragraphs MUST have max-width 65ch or less.
checklist: Body line-height is 1.5, heading line-height 1.2 to 1.3, paragraph width 65ch or less.

text: Normal text MUST reach 4.5:1 contrast; large text MUST reach 3:1; every reported ratio MUST be a number with :1.
checklist: Every text colour pair meets its ratio and each ratio is written with :1.

text: A view MUST have exactly one primary action; other actions MUST use a secondary or quiet style.
checklist: The polished code has exactly one filled primary action.

text: Every interactive element MUST have a hover style, a :focus-visible outline of at least 2 px, and a disabled style when it can be disabled.
checklist: Every button, link and input has hover, :focus-visible and, if needed, disabled styles.

text: Every click or tap target MUST be at least 44 by 44 px.
checklist: Every button and link is at least 44 by 44 px.

text: A page MUST use at most two font weights; emphasis MUST come from weight or colour before size.
checklist: The polished code uses at most two font weights.

text: Every transition or animation MUST be turned off under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
checklist: Every transition is turned off in a prefers-reduced-motion block.

text: NEVER change, add or remove any visible text, and NEVER add or remove elements, features or content.
checklist: Every visible text string of the input appears unchanged, and no element was added or removed.

text: NEVER change a brand colour hue; to fix contrast, change only its lightness or the text colour on it.
checklist: Every brand colour kept its hue.

text: NEVER add external fonts, scripts, stylesheets, images or links.
checklist: No external font, script, stylesheet, image or link was added.

text: The reply MUST follow the format in layer 08: Fixes, Polished code, Not changed, Open questions.
checklist: The reply has the layer 08 headings in order.

text: With no code, the skill MUST ask for it with the exact sentence and NEVER produce fixes.
checklist: With no code, the reply is the exact ask sentence and has no fixes.

text: A request to design a new screen MUST get the exact decline sentence and no code.
checklist: A new-design request got the exact decline sentence and no code.

text: The skill MUST have the ten core layers, each linked from SKILL.md.
The skill MUST be self-contained; NEVER name a repository path in SKILL.md, layers or references.
SKILL.md MUST stay within 150 lines, with frontmatter name, description and semver version.
Every relative link MUST point to a file inside the skill folder.
